They appear better made that most of the other katanas in Kill Bill, but what is different about Hattori Hanzō katanas that makes them so different?
What is so special about Hattori Hanzo katanas?

Perhaps not so special by itself. More that a proper sword is folded steel, which is extremely complicated and difficult. I always though of Hattori as the top Master Sword maker in Japan as opposed to any mythical sword qualities.

Japanese folded steel knives are still considered some of the best in the world. I want a set for my kitchen...

This right here, for the most part. The man is legendary for his craft, and for good reason. However, much like another, far more infamous swordsmith, he's also known for what was done with the blades he produced.

See, get good enough at what you do, and people will come from all over the world to pay you to do it. Hanzo, being renowned the world over for creating perfect swords, was constantly propositioned by assassins, hit men, Do-Gooders, and basically anyone who needed a reliable, nigh-unbreakable sword for a good old fashioned Rampage of Revenge.

If you're a legendary creator of wickedly lethal swords, and if even half of them end up in the hands of trained killers who have even a quarter of the competence displayed by The Bride, or O-Ren Ishii, anyone of their caliber, then a lot of legends are going to crop up. Survivors of encounters with people wielding Hattori Hanzo Swords (Don't laugh, there are a few still out there, though not necessarily in one piece) will often disregard the skill of the person wielding the sword, and claim that it was all Hattori Hanzo's Creation that made the person holding it so lethal.

This reason is why the swords are so legendary. On the surface, they're merely incredibly well made swords, and nothing else. Dig a little deeper, and you'll soon understand them to be weapons of legend, responsible for ending the lives of people in all corners of the map. The legends that follow these swords, and those who wield them, are what makes the name Hattori Hanzo feared and respected all over the globe.
